description:
When three illagers discover a portal deep underground, their ambition takes a sinister turn. Witness the rise of the Illager High Council in the Minecraft Dungeons II opening cinematic as chaos threatens not one, but two worlds. Grab a weapon, rally your party, and clash with never-before-seen threats in a quest to stop them and their soul corrupted forces!
Get Minecraft Dungeons II at: https://www.minecraft.net/store/minecraft-dungeons-ii-deluxe-edition
